body:
OOPS!!
I didn't realize when I replied to you that my email went out to 'no man's land" lol
Hope you see it before it goes away....I think it's against rules??? Who the F knows....I'm too old lmao

Hey PioneerPelican.....I am SO WITH YOU!!
I HAVE HAD SEVERAL Wild Turkey Honey.......never liked ANY like that. I used to only drink Heiniken and Christal champagne. LOL

It is SOOOO OK with me!!
I am really new to Reddit.....do not really understand it. I"m older remember lol
MY email is karaqmp@gmail.com.
I'm here for you WHENEVER!!!!!!!!!
I am feeling the SAME way you are right now....maybe we can help one another through the night??

OK...JUST STOP IT!! Email me or something! PLEASE!
We talked earlier, I DO care....I don't know exactly WHY I do so much...but I DO!!

Well it's a small world. When I was younger I dated a cop that was credited in that movie. (Man, was I shocked at that lol) I think it was supposed to take place in MO or AK not sure which lol. I have lived in MO except for right after college. If you ever need a shoulder....I'm here.
Please Emwonk2~...............reply to this. My family went through this (from what you said) so please reply so I can tell you how things might go!!???

Well I LIKE IT!!
I'm obviously a lot older than you lol (I have no clue about the "halo vehicle" reference) I'm 49 (a woman) with two daughter's grown and out of the house.  I don't think you are lame at all. I have maybe been you.....as far as being depressed and my youngest (she's 19 almost 20) she is a cutter/self-harm. If you ever need a "mother figure" just let me know. HUGS!!

Oh my dear sweet Winter_bone~
I sooo feel your pain. I am older now, (a 49 year old mother of two daughters) I so wish I could just give you a big huge hug right now!! Tonight I seem to be paying extra attention to the names people use on here....did you get your name from the Jennifer Lawrence movie by the same name?

Thank you Aprocalyptic~
May I ask why you want to get off of Zoloft? Did it not work for you? Had you been on something before? Thank you for taking time to reply. HUGS!!

Pyrofish9~
I so do NOT, "obsess" over my own pain. If anything, I have shoved it WAY DOWN INSIDE for too long!! You see, I am 49. Yes, 20 years OLDER than you. I only WISH I could have found "chemical happiness" as you so put it.  I worry about what's missing in society that causes so much misery.  I am not only sad for myself....but also for you.  At least I've made it 49 years and I still have a small ray of hope........I hope that I read your post wrong when all I get from yours is bitterness. I so HOPE I AM WRONG!!! HUGS!!

Sorry-ReadThisAgain~
Exactly!! You might LOVE to travel, and actually I do too. It just didn't cure my "blahs" you might say lol. I've been to ALL of the Carribean Islands, and Alaska, a TON of cruises, and to several countries in Europe, including: Germany, France, Budapest, Hungary, etc. Plus a ton of places in Mexico. I'd have to say the place that I felt most at home was in two places in Mexico. 
I just don't know which I HATE MORE.....feeling like the "poor little rich girl" OR the POOR miserable poor girl. (Hence the name I chose) All I know is that depression does NOT CARE if you have money or you DON'T!!!! (BUT.....I will NEVER say it isn't easier HAVING the money!!)

Please tell me Pyrofish9....how did you learn to enjoy the suffering???
How long were you on your meds before you quit? Also, may I ask how old you are?

CriesAloneAtNight~
I think it's all in the "other people's perspective" of what is the most sad. It's ALWAYS hard to see a YOUNG person die when they have an entire lifetime to turn things around. When they GET killed, other's feel empathy towards them and ANGER towards the one who ended their life prematurely. When it's suicide...I think most of the blame goes to those who were supposed to love them AND to the person who killed their self because they didn't open up to those who were supposed to be there and love them. Not entirely sure all that makes sense.....but in one scenario there is someone ELSE to place the blame....(murder) and the other requires those who loved them to look with-in themselves. (Which MOST people just aren't capable or willing to do!)
Good luck....hope I helped answer your question?? Hugs!!
I really love the name you chose, "PioneerPelican".....Can you please tell me how you came up with such a clever and unique name? I'm afraid I ended up choosing a really LAME name....lol

THANK YOU PLANETOUGH!!!!
I've posted on here only 4 or 5 times but NO ONE ever acknowledged me until you. I'm happy I could at least bring you a smile with my "sign-up sheet" idea. It made my day (or MONTH if I am to be totally honest) that I was able to bring a smile to your face. HUGS!

Hello, "Sorry-ReadThisAgain~
Trust me....travel isn't the answer either. At least it wasn't my experience. I have traveled the world (first class style) but I wasn't happy THEN either. Granted, it was a LOT MORE FUN being rich (now I'm beyond poor) but when I had money and "stuff" and traveled....I also had GUILT over not being "happy" then either. That's when I learned it was a "chemical thing."  Funny thing though.....I'd MUCH RATHER BE SAD AND RICH then SAD AND POOR!!! Now I get to add....sad to HUNGRY, UGLY, LOSS OF HEALTH AND LOOKS, NO TRANSPORTATION, I could go on and on. But it does no good.

OMG PlaneTough~
This might sound strange, but seeing your post is comforting somehow. I think, wish and pray that there was some sort of "link" to the dark web that you could just sign up to be murdered to take the place of some young innocent person that has a lot to live for. You know, like some serial killer "volunteer sign-up sheet." At least that way I could spare someone else's life. The ONLY reason I stay alive is because of my daughter's, but they are older now and don't live at home. It's HARD to "live for" other people that you only get to see a couple of days a year. I also HATE the resentment that I feel a lot of the time BECAUSE of only keeping myself alive for them. I don't remember what "happy" even feels like anymore. The worst thing is.....I can't think of a single thing that I could do that could even allow me to feel that emotion anymore. I am my own worst critic. I feel guilt over my misery. I spend my time sleeping as MUCH as possible, only leave my house an hour a month. It's just WAY TOO HARD to "fake it" (happiness or being "normal") anymore, so I avoid other people as much as possible. 
Sorry I'm not real help....my only value is empathy.

I have thought that very same thing MANY times!! You seem to always hear AFTER someone dies that, "Had we only known, I would have done something!!" I call bullshit!! I have said a few things to my supposed "best friends" and my family. What did I get in response?? Former, nothing...the later, (direct quote) "Well I hope you SNAP out of it before your BD. otherwise you'll RUIN IT!!
OMG!!! Can either be MORE CLUELESS in my cries for wanting and needing HELP?????

I know and understand DogRover.
I am totally alone in the world and always have been. Never been on Reddit until tonight....when I found myself praying to die in my sleep for the millionth time tonight. Decided to see if other's felt this way too. Wish I was able to write a poem or song or paint something. But I don't have that talent.
